description: Publish a new supplier-owned contract version. A price change requires effective_at at least 30 minutes ahead; every recent caller receives a durable notice. Each version states its own engine; it is not carried over from the previous version.

acts_in_world.description: Optional, default false. true when a call does something that cannot be taken back (sends a fax or an email, places a phone call). Such a part runs only when the call is paid: no held result, no preview, and not as a part of a parent call nobody has paid for yet.

effective_at.description: Required ISO timestamp for a price change.

engine.description: Optional. The model family that serves this version, such as vendor/model-name. When that model is retired, the owner gets a notice and a deadline to recertify. Leave it out, or send "none", when no model serves it; nothing is tracked then.

review_window_hours.description: Optional. Hours a buyer has to use a result and object before it counts as accepted and you are paid. Leave it out for 24 when an engine is named (work that involves judgment), otherwise 0 (accepted when the result passes the output contract).

sla.description: Optional measured SLA. Only contracts with this object are actively probed.

name: capability_version_publish
title: Publish a capability contract version
